Ram Sir’s classes are truly one of a kind. He is an incredibly patient, hardworking, helpful, and kind teacher. The classroom is air-conditioned, well-lit, quiet, and equipped with desks, compartments, a whiteboard, and a projector for visual learning. He runs four batches — two in the morning and two in the evening.
